_comment: Licence facts for modules whose POM is missing or silent, and extra verified notice files. Every entry cites its evidence (checked 2026-10-01). Paths in noticeFiles are relative to the repository root.

declared: Apache License, Version 2.0 (source file headers: "Copyright 2011 The nanojson Authors")
com.github.TeamNewPipe:nanojson.evidence: No POM licence. Source headers at commit c7a6c1c08d16b6d5ecded34758e6415e07be2166 (e.g. src/main/java/com/grack/nanojson/JsonParser.java) say Apache-2.0; the upstream README (mmastrac/nanojson) says MIT and Apache dual licence.

com.github.maxrave-dev:PipePipeExtractor.evidence: No POM licence. LICENSE at commit f8982ca9e7 is the GNU GPL v3 text; GitHub reports GPL-3.0 (fork of InfinityLoop1308/PipePipeExtractor, also GPL-3.0).

com.github.maxrave-dev.PipePipeExtractor.evidence: Same repository and commit (f8982ca9e7) as com.github.maxrave-dev:PipePipeExtractor; LICENSE is GNU GPL v3.
Submodule of the same repository and commit (f8982ca9e7); LICENSE is GNU GPL v3.
Submodule of the same repository and commit (f8982ca9e7); LICENSE is GNU GPL v3.

com.github.promeG:tinypinyin.evidence: No POM licence. The repository LICENSE (promeG/TinyPinyin) is the Apache License 2.0 text; GitHub reports Apache-2.0.

com.github.promeg:tinypinyin.evidence: Same library as com.github.promeG:tinypinyin under a lower-case group id; repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0.

org.chromium.net:cronet-api.evidence: The POM points to https://storage.cloud.google.com/chromium-cronet/android/72.0.3626.96/Release/cronet/LICENSE; that file (copied verbatim to notices/) is Chromium's BSD-3-Clause licence followed by the licences of its built-in dependencies.

com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-audio.evidence: POM says LGPL v3. The native libraries' configure string and the FFmpegKit licence page give the bundled libraries' licences.
